dct_description_sm: To obtain a detailed description of the pigments associated with the phytoplankton community. The pigment analyses from the year-long study in the coastal Beaufort Sea of the western Canadian Arctic showed the continuous prevalence  of pigments associated with eukaryotic picoplankton in the green algal class Prasinophyceae. These results confirmed the presence of Micromonas observed by microscopy.
dct_title_s: HPLC Pigment Analysis of the Phytoplankton Community in Franklin Bay
